obligor_name: Penn Medicine (University of Pennsylvania Health System)

moodys.citation_text: Moody's assigned Aa3 ratings to University of Pennsylvania Health System's (UPHS) proposed Health System Refunding Revenue Bonds Series A and B of 2021. Aa3 and Aa3/VMIG 1 ratings on outstanding debt were affirmed, with a stable outlook.
moodys.verification_note: Most recent Moody's affirmation prior to window start was March 2021 at Aa3 stable. No intervening rating action found through 2022-12-31.

sp.citation_text: University Of Pennsylvania Health System Series 2 | S&P Global Ratings reference; UPHS S&P rating maintained at AA- per S&P regulatory disclosure entries indexed for the obligor.
sp.verification_note: S&P long-term rating for UPHS has been AA- for multiple years; trade press references through 2024 are consistent. Direct S&P press release at 2022-year-end not accessed (paywalled).

fitch.citation_text: Penn Medicine carries upper-AA-tier credit ratings from all three agencies (Moody's Aa3, S&P AA-, Fitch AA-) per Becker's compilations of strong-finance health systems through 2023.
fitch.verification_note: Fitch direct rating action prior to window start not retrieved; rating inferred from Becker's strong-finance compilations and the absence of any Fitch downgrade/upgrade reporting for UPHS in 2023-2025 trade press.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Moody's noted UPHS's proposed acquisition of Doylestown Health would be credit positive for Doylestown and credit neutral for UPHS; UPHS Aa3 stable maintained
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Doylestown merger announcement; Moody's specifically called the action credit neutral for UPHS
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Philadelphia-based University of Pennsylvania Health System's proposed acquisition of Doylestown Health is expected to be credit positive for Doylestown and credit neutral for UPHS, according to Moody's.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's commentary on UPHS through 2024 references the existing Aa3 rating as credit-neutral to the Doylestown acquisition. No subsequent downgrade or upgrade reported in trade press through 2025-Q1.

sp.citation_text: UPHS S&P rating carried through window at AA- per regulatory disclosure entries; no downgrade/upgrade reported in trade press.

fitch.citation_text: Penn Medicine continued to carry Fitch AA- through window; no Fitch action reported in trade press.

outcome_class_rationale: Penn Medicine/UPHS carried high-AA-tier ratings throughout the window. The Doylestown acquisition was specifically called credit-neutral by Moody's. No downgrades or outlook revisions found in trade press for 2023-2025-Q1. Financial performance was strong with $10B+ FY24 revenue and $278M operating profit.

primary_sources_obtained: Moody's Aa3 assignment 2021 (Yahoo Finance press release index)
